workload.note: Rookie year (2025 4th-round pick, No. 136): 16 games (14 starts), 89 tgt/41 rec/515 rec yds/4 TD. High target volume relative to catch rate -- 46% catch rate on a run-heavy/turnover-prone 2025 offense.

scheme.oc: Brian Daboll (new OC for 2026, reported hire)

notes: Aug 9, 2026 depth-chart breakdown groups Ayomanor with Chimere Dike and Bryce Oliver as the 'third receiver' tier behind Ridley/Robinson/Tate -- he is not the clear-cut WR2 or WR3 yet; it's a crowded room with at least 5-6 real competitors for 2026 targets.

Aug 6, 2026 outlook piece (Last Word on Sports) frames Ayomanor as a second-year breakout candidate who could become Cam Ward's favorite target, competing directly with Ridley, Robinson, and Tate for volume -- a more bullish read than the depth-chart tiering above; note the conflict.
